lines.rom: sisa gamga ardhanga parvati sada virajata kailasi nandi bhrngi nrtya karata haim dharata dhyana sura sukharasi
sitala manda sugandha pavana baha baithe haim siva avinasi karata gana gandharva sapta svara raga ragini madhurasi
yaksa raksa bhairava jaham dolata bolata haim vanake vasi koyala sabda sunavata sundara bhramara karata haim gunja si
kalpadruma aru parijata taru laga rahe haim laksasi kamadhenu kotina jaham dolata karata dugdha ki varsa si
suryakanta sama parvata sobhita candrakanta sama himarasi nitya chahom rtu rahata susobhita sevata sada prakrti dasi
rsi muni deva danuja nita sevata gana karata sruti gunarasi brahma visnu niharata nisidina kachu siva hamakum pharamasi
suryakanta sama parvata sobhita candrakanta sama himarasi nitya chahom rtu rahata susobhita sevata sada prakrti dasi
rsi muni deva danuja nita sevata gana karata sruti gunarasi brahma visnu niharata nisidina kachu siva hamakum pharamasi
rddhi siddhike data samkara nita sat cit anamdarasi jinake sumirata hi kata jati kathina kala yamaki phamsi
trisuladharajika nama nirantara prema sahita jo nara gasi dura hoya vipada usa nara ki janma janma sivapada pasi
kailasi kasi ke vasi avinasi meri sudha lijo sevaka jana sada caranana ko apano jana krpa kijo
tuma to prabhuji sada dayamaya avaguna mere saba dhakiyo saba aparadha ksamakara samkara kimkaraki vinati suniyo
